headline: MarketAxess Holdings (MKTX) On Its ICE Deal, Bargain Or Already Fully Valued?
summary: Intercontinental Exchange has agreed to acquire MarketAxess Holdings (MKTX) in an all-cash deal valuing the company at about $6 billion, offering shareholders $167 per share and a 33% premium to the prior close. See our latest analysis for MarketAxess Holdings.
